results.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
results.proof_sketch: Fix the orientations and minimize the sum of all left and top coordinates over the compact feasible configuration space. Every sheet not on x=0 then has a left blocker, and every sheet not on y=0 has a top blocker; otherwise a translation chosen below the finite minimum positive clearance to every potential obstruction would decrease the objective. Following blockers strictly decreases the relevant coordinate and terminates at the boundary. Thus every right and bottom edge is a nonnegative sum 52i+37j. Exact enumeration shows that the largest such sum at most 1189 is 1188=20·52+4·37 and the largest at most 841 is 839=14·52+3·37; 1189, 840, and 841 are not representable. Hence all sheets lie in [0,1188]×[0,839].

results.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
results.proof_sketch: Write placements as (x,y;w,h). Use three disjoint grids: (i) (52i,37j;52,37) for 0≤i<20 and 0≤j<3, giving 60 sheets in [0,1040]×[0,111]; (ii) (1040+37i,52j;37,52) for 0≤i<4 and 0≤j<2, giving 8 sheets in [1040,1188]×[0,104]; and (iii) (37i,111+52j;37,52) for 0≤i<32 and 0≤j<14, giving 448 sheets below y=111. The grids are mutually interior-disjoint and contained in 1188×839. Their total is 60+8+448=516.

results.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
results.proof_sketch: On the reduced 1188×839 unit grid, mark precisely the cells whose lower-left coordinates satisfy x+y≡50 (mod 52), assigning each marked cell weight 1/37 and all other cells weight zero. Every 52×37 placement contains one marked cell in each of its 37 rows; every 37×52 placement contains one in each of its 37 columns. Thus every sheet has weight exactly 1. Exact residue counting gives 19,162 marked cells, so the total weight is 19,162/37=517+33/37<518. Nonoverlap and integrality therefore imply that a packing contains at most 517 sheets.

results.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
results.proof_sketch: Its sheets have area 517·52·37=994708, whereas 1187·838=994706. Consequently its normalized bounding box cannot have both width at most 1187 and height at most 838: it must span width 1188 or height 839. In the first case, a left-blocking chain ending at x=1188 has total widths 1188. The unique representation is 1188=20·52+4·37, so that chain contains twenty 52×37 and four 37×52 sheets. In the second case, a top-blocking chain has the unique height composition 839=3·37+14·52. This is necessary only and does not exclude 517.

results.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
results.proof_sketch: Area gives OPT(1188,111)≤68, attained by the 60+8 top grids above. For a packing of N sheets in 1188×728, let n be the number oriented 52×37. For every vertical line, feasible intersection counts (h,v) satisfy 5h+7v≤98 whenever 37h+52v≤728. Summing over all columns gives 259N+n≤98·1188=116424. For every horizontal line, 52h+37v≤1188 implies 7h+5v≤160; summing gives 260N−n≤160·728=116480. Hence 519N≤232904<519·449, so N≤448. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 sheets attains 448. Thus this fixed split permits exactly 68+448=516, not 517.

results.claim: The maximum size of a guillotine (slicing) A9-in-A0 packing is 516.
results.proof_sketch: Call a packing slicing if it is recursively separable by full vertical or horizontal cuts. Compact its slicing tree bottom-up: a leaf has side lengths 37 and 52; at a vertical node add the child widths and take the larger child height, and at a horizontal node do the converse. The compacted root still fits A0, and both side lengths belong to the semigroup ⟨37,52⟩, hence are at most 1188 and 839. An exact dynamic program used all 396 representable widths through 1188 and all 204 representable heights through 839. Each state includes both uniform grids, monotone slack transitions, every division into two representable widths, and every division into two representable heights. Structural induction on the slicing tree proves recurrence coverage. Integer evaluation gives G(1188,839)=516, while the displayed 516 construction is slicing, proving equality. Thus any hypothetical 517-packing must be nonslicing.

final_writeup:
The rigorously established interval remains

516 ≤ OPT(1189,841,52,37) ≤ 517.

Normalization. Fix orientations and minimize the sum of all left and top coordinates in the compact feasible configuration space. A sheet away from a corresponding boundary has a genuine left or top blocker; otherwise a translation smaller than every positive clearance improves the objective. Blocker chains strictly decrease the relevant coordinate and terminate at zero. Consequently all sheet edges are sums of 37 and 52. The largest such horizontal sum at most 1189 is 1188, and the largest such vertical sum at most 841 is 839. Thus arbitrary real-coordinate packings reduce without loss to integer-coordinate packings in 1188×839.

Lower certificate. Use the three coordinate grids

(52i,37j;52,37), 0≤i<20, 0≤j<3;
(1040+37i,52j;37,52), 0≤i<4, 0≤j<2;
(37i,111+52j;37,52), 0≤i<32, 0≤j<14.

They are mutually interior-disjoint and contain 60+8+448=516 sheets.

Upper certificate. Mark a unit cell (x,y) of the reduced container exactly when x+y≡50 mod 52 and give it weight 1/37. A 52×37 sheet receives one marker in every row, and a 37×52 sheet receives one in every column, so either orientation has weight exactly one. The container has 19,162 markers and total weight 19,162/37=517+33/37<518. Therefore OPT≤517, excluding 518.

There is also an elementary check against 518. Such a packing would leave only 100 cells uncovered, hence would have at least 1,088 full columns and 739 full rows. A full column has the unique decomposition 839=3·37+14·52, while a full row has the unique decomposition 1188=20·52+4·37. If n counts 52×37 sheets, full rows force n≥400, whereas full columns force n≤106, a contradiction.

Necessary structure at 517. Since 517·52·37=994,708>1187·838=994,706, a normalized 517-packing reaches x=1188 or y=839. Its associated blocker chain is rigid: respectively twenty width-52 plus four width-37 sheets, or three height-37 plus fourteen height-52 sheets. Moreover, the natural horizontal 111+728 architecture is capped at 68+448=516.

A new exhaustive slicing restriction broadens that last result. Compacting any guillotine tree recursively produces semigroup side lengths. The exact two-direction slicing recurrence over the 396 possible widths and 204 possible heights returns 516, attained by the displayed construction. Hence a 517-packing, if one exists, must be genuinely nonslicing as well as cross the fixed y=111 split.

Target coverage and resolution. The target asks which of 516, 517, and 518 is exact. The certificates prove 516≤OPT≤517 and exclude broad classes of 517 layouts, but they do not exclude every nonslicing packing. The choice between 516 and 517 therefore remains unresolved. The claimed resolution is PARTIAL, not FULL.
